name: TEN-E0 tennis evaluator baseline
summary: Baseline tennis evaluator cartridge consumed by TEN-T0. It records settlement, lane grading, and calibration expectations without changing evaluator math.
keyImprovements: Gives the tennis evaluator layer a canonical sport-prefixed cartridge identity.
Keeps ML, spread, match total, first-set total, set-win, and Kalshi trade grading separate.
Makes settled runs auditable without mutating locked pregame predictions.

keyMetrics.label: Required buckets
keyMetrics.details: ML, spread, match total, first-set total, set-win, and Kalshi trade-to-sell.

keyMetrics.label: Settlement rule
keyMetrics.details: Postmatch grading writes settlement artifacts without changing the locked prediction run.

notes: TEN-E0 is a component cartridge, not a standalone prediction model.
Future evaluator changes should become TEN-E1+ and report which lane improved or degraded.
ROI and hit rate must be reported by lane rather than collapsed into one generic accuracy number.
